Carved Meerschaum Pipe Bearded Man Helmet Head 7 Inch Velvet Case
This carved meerschaum tobacco pipe features a detailed head of a bearded man wearing a helmet, likely representing a historical or mythological figure. The pipe is made from white meerschaum (hydrous magnesium silicate), known for its use in high-quality smoking pipes. It includes a curved dark acrylic or vulcanite stem. The pipe measures approximately 7 inches in length and comes with a fitted hard case lined with brown velvet. A stamped or engraved floral mark is present on the side. The pipe is gently used, showing minor discoloration inside the bowl, and is in good collectible condition.
